searchText: cool, another Q: is there a specific reason why the block gas limit converges to 30M? Do you mean why 30M instead of 31M? Or do you mean why does it converge on a particular number? both 🙂 The mechanism for it converging can be seen in https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-1559. As to why 30M, that is basically an arbitrary number that "felt right" to some unknown group of people in the past and these things are sticky. I personally think 30M is way too high given that we haven't solved the state growth problem yet. where does it explain the convergence? you just want to see high txn fees haha Fees adjust up if the gas used is over 15M, fees adjust down if it is below 15M.
